_sheet: UI sounds, synthesised in code when the plugin loads (no audio files). One row = one sound; ui.json soundOn refers to these ids. Generated/SoundTable.cs gets one SoundDef per row.

_columns.kind: tick (short sine click) | chime (decaying bell notes, one after another) | whoosh (filtered noise sweeping from freqs[0] to freqs[1])
_columns.freqs: Hz; tick uses the first, chime plays each in turn, whoosh sweeps first to second

rows.use: the cursor moves onto a card
